note: Jo Daviess County (IL) publishes parcel ownership boundaries only through a Subscription Map Portal (subscription required). The public GIS map portal (gismaps.jodaviess.org, gismaps.jodaviesscountyil.gov) has only base layers (townships, roads, corporate boundaries); no public ArcGIS REST parcel service was found on county sites, ArcGIS Hub/Online searches (only karst, spring, survey and aerial layers), or web searches. Parcel data is otherwise sold by commercial vendors. Subscription gate not worked around.
